subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word in the given sentence.

When I reported the cashier’s poor customer service, the manager tried to __**appease**__ me with the offer of a free pizza.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Inflame**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"appease"** means to calm, pacify, or soothe someone by acceding to their demands or providing concessions. (शांत करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The parents tried to appease their crying child with a toy.
 
 
 
• **"Inflame"** refers to provoking or intensifying feelings of anger, rage, or emotional disturbance. It is the opposite of appease, which seeks to calm someone down. (भड़काना)
 
 
• **Example:** His insensitive remarks inflamed the crowd, making them more agitated.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'appease'** is **'inflame'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Inflame**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Suppress** (दबाना): To forcibly put an end to something or restrain it.

 
 
• **Example:** The government tried to suppress the protests with strict measures.
 
 
 
• **Foster** (प्रोत्साहित करना): To encourage or promote the development of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The organization aims to foster creativity among young artists.
 
 
 
• **Enrich** (समृद्ध करना): To improve or enhance the quality or value of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Reading books can enrich your vocabulary and knowledge.
